title: Senior Frontend Developer
body: We're looking for an experienced React developer to lead frontend architecture and mentor junior developers. You'll work on cutting-edge projects for enterprise clients.
responsibilities: Collaborate with design and backend teams
bonuses: Annual performance bonus, equity options, unlimited PTO

title: UI/UX Designer
body: Join our design team to create beautiful, user-centered interfaces. Experience with Figma and design systems required.
bonuses: Quarterly bonus, health insurance, professional development fund

title: Full Stack Developer
body: Build end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Work in an agile environment with a collaborative team.
bonuses: Annual bonus, stock options, flexible hours

title: DevOps Engineer
body: Manage cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes required.

title: Junior Web Developer
body: Great opportunity for developers early in their career. You'll learn from experienced mentors while working on real projects.
bonuses: Learning stipend, mentorship program, growth opportunities

title: Product Manager
body: Define product strategy and roadmap for our client projects. Work closely with design and engineering teams to deliver exceptional products.
